propositions: Prior plan-review findings recalled without re-grounding against current plan text are re-verified and re-persisted indistinguishably from fresh findings, creating a self-feeding ratchet that replays zero-evidence findings across consecutive review rounds.

Pass-2 validity verification fails to act as a backstop because recalled candidates are injected with hardcoded empty evidence and empty impact, so the verifier confirms bare assertions instead of testing whether current plan text refutes the claim.

Prior findings with no persisted grounding evidence (the signature of previous recall injections) must be declared ineligible for recall, breaking the ratchet on already-written sidecars without migration.

Recall must be suppressed when the prior sidecar's material_fingerprint differs from the current one, since fresh finder silence on changed material is evidence the edit resolved the finding, not a miss.
